interpretation_scope.evaluated: Text graph plus latent current/goal tokens replacing text node IDs; the text control received explicit node IDs.
interpretation_scope.requested: Same full text graph and current/goal node IDs in every condition, with roadmap added only to the experimental condition.
interpretation_scope.template_note: Canonical and heldout prompts are semantic paraphrases with reversed role order; both requested node-ID-only output. Grammar constraints are a separate diagnostic dimension.
interpretation_scope.scoring_note: Historical strict-format scores are preserved and are not semantic-action scores under the revised user requirement.

original.interpretation: Single-seed fixed-graph pilot; no unseen-node or cross-graph claim.
